title: WHEN SYNTHETIC USERS FAIL: A CROSS-DOMAIN BENCHMARK OF LLM-SIMULATED HUMAN SURVEY RESPONSES
reasoning: The paper evaluates LLMs using datasets like the World Values Survey (WVS) and the General Social Survey (GSS), which contain explicit questions benchmarking moral justifiability, societal values, and religiosity (e.g., questions asking about the importance of God and reliance on faith versus science).
